title: documenting my attempt to make $1m from algo trading before i graduate high school
author: Quantingit
selftext:
hey, i’m Vihaan. i’m a high school freshman working on trading strategies, and my goal is to make $1m from algo trading before graduation.

ambitious considering i still have homework, but i want to give it a serious attempt.

i started a free newsletter called **probably overfit** to document the process twice a week: research, backtests, code, my thought process, and whatever falls apart when i test it more carefully.

i want to keep a record of how my ideas change and give other people enough detail to try things themselves. hopefully someone reads it, thinks “i could test that,” and starts their own project.

also hoping to meet other aspiring quants, especially students, who want to compare experiments and question each other’s results. would be nice to have people who understand why watching a backtest finish counts as entertainment.

[here’s my first post if you want to follow along](https://thevihaanjuneja.substack.com/p/im-a-highschool-freshman-and-i-want)

if you’re working on a strategy or researching something interesting, tell me about it.
